summary: Switched from the desktop path to an always-on web build of Gizmo: extracted a shared managed-daemon core from scripts/dev-server.ts into scripts/lib/managed-daemon.ts, added a scripts/web-server.ts that produces a production build and runs vite preview on port 4173 (proxying /agent to the agent server on 8787), added `web:server` scripts to package.json, registered a Windows scheduled task "Gizmo Web" that runs at logon and every 5 minutes via a hidden VBS shim calling .gizmo-web/startup.cmd, configured origin allowlist via GIZMO_WEB_HOSTS to include the Tailscale hostname (100.105.88.93 / genge.angler-musical.ts.net), and verified the launcher revives the daemon and serves HTTP 200 on both 127.0.0.1 and the Tailscale address.
decisions: Serve the web UI via a production build plus `vite preview` on port 4173, rather than a static file server, so the same-origin `/agent` websocket proxy to the agent server on 8787 keeps working.

Auto-start with a Windows Task Scheduler logon trigger that repeats every 5 minutes, launched through a hidden .vbs shim (.gizmo-web/startup.vbs) rather than the .cmd directly, so the repeating trigger does not flash a console window.

Extract a shared managed-daemon core (scripts/lib/managed-daemon.ts) and reuse it from both the dev web server and the new production web server, instead of duplicating the ~350-line spawn/state logic of scripts/dev-server.ts.

Configure allowed origins for the agent websocket via the new GIZMO_WEB_HOSTS env var (defaulted in startup.cmd to localhost,127.0.0.1,100.105.88.93,genge.angler-musical.ts.net), so the Tailscale hostname/IP can reach the server.

In startup.cmd prepend the mise shims directory to PATH before invoking pnpm; a scheduled task's non-interactive environment otherwise resolves node to the stale system v22.9.0 and pnpm refuses to run.

The launcher is idempotent (the daemon's start path checks for an existing running PID and returns without spawning a duplicate), so the 5-minute repeat trigger safely re-runs startup.cmd without stacking processes.
errors: Scheduled task initially exited with code 1 even though .gizmo-web/startup.cmd worked in an interactive shell. Root cause: the scheduled task's non-interactive environment resolved node to C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe (v22.9.0) instead of mise's v24.20.0, and pnpm 10.34.5 requires Node >= 22.13. Fixed by prepending %LOCALAPPDATA%\mise\shims to PATH in startup.cmd; after the fix LastTaskResult=0 and HTTP 200 was confirmed on both 127.0.0.1:4173 and 100.105.88.93:4173.
